a:r.a:t: IT PMO Support for IT System Design and Integration for Hospitality Subsidiary of major Regional Aviation group in GCC
The client is the newly formed hospitality subsidiary of one of the major Aviation players in the GCC region, who sought support in establishing end-to-end CRM with relevant IT infrastructure
to set up and run an IT PMO to govern multiple strategic initiatives across core systems, channels and travel-tech integrations.
The mandate was to deliver projects on-time and with predictable quality while aligning vendors and internal teams to a common delivery framework.
Major vendors are Juniper BE, Salesforce and Hotelbeds
: Built detailed project plans, milestone baselines and RAID logs, enabling early identification and resolution of risks and issues before they impacted scope, budget or timelines.
: Coordinated end‑to‑end delivery with Juniper BE, Salesforce (
) and Hotelbeds, aligning contracts, integration timelines and dependencies across all vendors.
: Oversaw complete SIT and UAT cycles, tracking defects, clarifications and sign‑offs to ensure all functional and technical requirements were fully validated before go‑live.
: Introduced standard PMO dashboards and C‑level status reports, giving leadership clear visibility into progress, risks and decisions.
: All in-scope projects were delivered within agreed timelines and without major production incidents to ensure successful launch
: Supported GFH business and IT teams during onboarding, provided process and tool training, and ensured a smooth transition and handover of PMO practices.
: Established a central document repository for BRDs, technical designs, test artefacts and sign‑offs, creating a single source of truth for audits and future enhancements.
Clarify objectives, scope, stakeholders, and overall governance.
Build the integrated project plan, roles, and documentation standards.
Drive day‑to‑day delivery, managing tasks, dependencies, and risks.
Oversee SIT/UAT cycles, defects, and business sign‑offs.
Train GFH teams, support go‑live, and complete knowledge transfer.
